source.bar_text: De Isar is a Fluss, der wo vo de Oipn durch Minga fliaßt und letzendlich gengiba vo Degndorf in d Donau münden duat.

outputs.target_text: The Isar is a river that flows from the Alps through Munich and ultimately flows into the Danube opposite Deggendorf.

source.bar_text: Da Ursprung liagt in Estareich im Hinteraudoi vom Kawendl-Gebirg.

outputs.target_text: The origin lies in Austria in the Hinterautal of the Kaunertal mountains.

source.bar_text: Zwischn Scharnitz und Mittnwoid fliaßts iaba d' Grenz vo Estareich noch Bayern (Deitschland).

outputs.target_text: Between Scharnitz and Mittnwoid, it flows across the border from Austria to Bavaria (Germany).

source.bar_text: Se hod a Leng vo 295 Kilometa.

outputs.target_text: It has a length of 295 kilometers.

source.bar_text: Neba Minga liang de Städt Däiz, Freising, Moosburg und Landshuad an da Isar.

outputs.target_text: Besides Munich, there are two cities: Dachau, Freising, Moosburg and Landshut on the Isar.

source.bar_text: De greaßtn Zufliass han d' Amper bei Moosburg, d' Loisach bei Wolfratshausn und d' Moosach bei Freising.

outputs.target_text: The largest tributaries are the Amper near Moosburg, the Loisach near Wolfratshausen, and the Moosach near Freising.

source.bar_text: D' Isar is noch da Donau, am Inn und am Main da viertlängste Fluss in Bayern.

outputs.target_text: The Isar is, after the Danube, the Inn and the Main, the fourth longest river in Bavaria.

source.bar_text: Lange Zeit hods ghoaßn, der Nama Isar dad ausm keltischn kemma und sovui wia reißnds Wossa (ys = schnej, reißnd und ura = Wossa, Fluss) bedeitn.

outputs.target_text: For a long time it was said that the name Isar came from Celtic and meant something like rushing water (ys = snow, rushing and ura = water, river).

source.bar_text: Des guid inzwischn ois vaaltate Meinung.

outputs.target_text: That is now all an outdated opinion.

source.bar_text: D'Sprachforscher moana jetzad es dad vo da indogermanischn Wurzl es/is (fia fließnds Wossa) kemma, de se a in fui andane Flußnama wiadafindt und se in aktuelle Sprachn nua no aufs feste Wossa, oiso s Eis bziagt.

outputs.target_text: Language researchers now think that it would have come from the Indo-European root es/is (for flowing water), which they also find in many other river names, and in current languages it only refers to solid water, i.e., ice.

source.bar_text: A guads Drum vom Wossa des auf'd boarischn Oipn unds Kawendl foid fliaßt durch d' Isar zur Donau und so bis ins Schwoazze Meea.

outputs.target_text: A good amount of water that falls on the Bavarian Alps and the foothills flows through the Isar to the Danube and so on into the Black Sea.

source.bar_text: S' gsamte Einzugsgebiat hod a Flächn vo 9000 Quadratkilometa.

outputs.target_text: The entire catchment area has an area of 9000 square kilometers.

source.bar_text: Wei a Guads vom Niedaschlog in de Berg ois Schnee foid hods zur Schneeschmelz as meiste Wossa.

outputs.target_text: Because a good amount of precipitation fell in the mountains as snow, most of the water comes from the snowmelt.

source.bar_text: Mit am mittlern Abfluss vo 175 Kubikmeta in da Sekund zählt d' Isar zu de mittlgroßn deitschn Flüss.

outputs.target_text: With an average discharge of 175 cubic meters per second, the Isar is among the medium-sized German rivers.

source.bar_text: Ma kos sogseng mit am Lech, da Mosel, am Main und am Neckar vagleicha.

outputs.target_text: One can compare it with the Lech, the Moselle, the Main, and the Neckar.

source.bar_text: Da Ursprung vo da Isar liagt im Hinteraudoi im Karwendl auf 1.160 Meta iaba Normalnui ( Koordinaten fehlen! Hilf mit. ...).

outputs.target_text: The origin of the Isar lies in Hinteraudoi in the Karwendel at 1,160 meters above sea level (coordinates are missing! Help out. ...).

source.bar_text: Do fliaßt da Lafatsch an de Isarquelln vorbei.

outputs.target_text: There, Lafatsch flows past the Isar springs.

source.bar_text: Da Lafatsch hod sei Quelln in da Nach vom Hallerangerhaus.

outputs.target_text: Lafatsch has his spring in the vicinity of the Halleranger house.

source.bar_text: Er is da längste vo de Quellbäch.

outputs.target_text: He is the longest of the spring brooks.

source.bar_text: Sei Nama ändert se bei de Isarquelln in Isar, oafach wei de Quelln vui mehra Wassa bringa, ois ea sejba hod.

outputs.target_text: His name changes at the Isar springs to Isar, simply because the springs bring much more water than he himself has.

source.bar_text: In de Berg han ois wichtige Nebnflüß da Rißbach, d' Achn und d'Jachn zum dawähna.

outputs.target_text: In the mountains, we have important tributaries, the Rißbach, the Achn, and the Jachn, to mention.

source.bar_text: Da Rißbach kimmt aus da Eng und trifft bei Vorderriß auf d' Isar.

outputs.target_text: The Rißbach comes from the Eng and meets the Isar at Vorderriß.

source.bar_text: D'Achn kimmt vom Achensee und mündt in Sylvensteinsee, dem sei Zua- und Abfluß d' Isar is.

outputs.target_text: The Ache comes from the Achensee and flows into Sylvensteinsee, whose inflow and outflow is the Isar.

source.bar_text: D'Jachn kimmt vom Walchasee, fliaßt durch d' Jachenau und mündt in da Nach vo Fleck und Wegscheid.

outputs.target_text: The Jachn comes from the Walchsee, flows through the Jachenau and flows into the Isar near Fleck and Wegscheid.

source.bar_text: De wichtigstn Nebenflüß außahoib vo de Berg han d' Amper und d' Loisach.

outputs.target_text: The most important tributaries outside of the mountains are the Amper and the Loisach.

source.bar_text: De meistn Inseln und Kiesbänk in da Isar untaliegn wega de starkn Hochwassa a ständign Änderung in ihra Form und Log.

outputs.target_text: Most of the islands and gravel banks in the Isar are constantly changing in their shape and location due to the strong floods.

source.bar_text: D'Isar werd auf vaschiedne Artn zur Energie-Gewinnung gnutzt.

outputs.target_text: The Isar is used in various ways for energy production.

source.bar_text: A guada Tei vom Isarwossa werd in da Nach vo Mittnwoid zum Woichnsää umgleit.

outputs.target_text: A good part of the Isar water will be diverted to the grain field on Wednesday night.

source.bar_text: Des werd gmacht, wei s' Woichnsääkraftwerk mehra Wossa bracht, ois vo sejba in See fliaßt.

outputs.target_text: That will be done because the Woichnsää power plant brought more water than flows into the lake by itself.

source.bar_text: Da Sylvenstoa is a Stausee, dear vor oim gegas Hochwassa baut worn is, aba a zua Stromerzeugung gnutzt werd.

outputs.target_text: The Sylven Reservoir is a reservoir that was built primarily to protect against high water, but is also used for electricity generation.

source.bar_text: Im weidan Valauf gibts mehrane Flußkraftwerke z. B. am neadlichn Stadtrand vo Däiz und de Isarwerke 1-3 inahoib vo Minga.

outputs.target_text: In the further course, there are more hydroelectric power plants, e.g., on the northern outskirts of Deggendorf and the Isar plants 1-3 halfway to Munich.

source.bar_text: Neba da Nutzung vo da Wassakraft is as Isarwassa indirekt ois Kühlwassa fias Kernkraftwerk Isar bei Landshut vo Bedeitung.

outputs.target_text: Besides the use of hydropower, the Isar water is indirectly of importance as cooling water for the Isar nuclear power plant near Landshut.

source.bar_text: A wenn Wassakraft ois was recht umweltfreindlichs ogseng werd hods fia'd Isar einschneidnde Folgn.

outputs.target_text: Even if hydropower is being presented as something very environmentally friendly, it has decisive consequences for the Isar.

source.bar_text: Lange Zeit is as ganze Wassa zum Woichasee umgleit worn.

outputs.target_text: For a long time, all the water has been diverted to Lake Woichasee.

source.bar_text: Da a as meiste vom Rißboch zum Woichasee umgleit wurd is d'Isar zwischn Krea und am Sylvenstoa ab und zua a austrocknd.

outputs.target_text: Since most of the Rißbach was diverted to the Walchensee, the Isar between Kreuth and the Sylvenstein is occasionally drying up.

source.bar_text: Des ganze Wassa kimmt zwar letzendlich iaban Kochesee und Loisach wiada zruck in d'Isar, aba bis Wolfratshausn fejds im Flußlauf.

outputs.target_text: All the water does eventually come back into the Isar via the Kochelsee and Loisach, but it is missing from the river course up to Wolfratshausen.

source.bar_text: Inzwischn werd a greaßana Teil vom Wossa in da Isar glassn.

outputs.target_text: In the meantime, a larger part of the water is being let into the Isar.

source.bar_text: A de fuin Seitnkanäle fia de Flußkraftwerk z. B. in da Nach vo Minga entziehn am wildn Flußlauf as Wossa.

outputs.target_text: The diversion channels for the hydroelectric power plants, e.g., in the vicinity of Munich, withdraw the water from the wild river course.

source.bar_text: Außadem vahindern de Wehre an Transport vom Geschiebe.

outputs.target_text: In addition, the weirs prevent the transport of the debris.

source.bar_text: Deszweng grobt se d' Isar a tiafas Flußbett.

outputs.target_text: There, the Isar digs a deep riverbed.

source.bar_text: A de Nutzung ois Kühlwassa fias Kernkraftwerk tuat am Fluß ned guad, wei dadurch sei Temperatur steigt.

outputs.target_text: Using it as cooling water for the nuclear power plant is not good for the river, because its temperature rises as a result.

source.bar_text: Dafia gibts aba Grenzwert, in oam hoaßn Somma hod as Kernkraftwerk scho drosselt wern miaßn, weis sonst de Umweltauflagn ned dafüllt hed.

outputs.target_text: But there is a limit to that; in one hot summer, the nuclear power plant already had to be throttled, because otherwise the environmental requirements would not have been met.

source.bar_text: Fast scho zum Nama dazua gheard ois Zuasotz da Farbeidruck.

outputs.target_text: The color print almost belongs to the name as an addition.

source.bar_text: S' is ois greane Isar bekannt.

outputs.target_text: It is known to all of green Isar.

source.bar_text: Des is aba nua de Farb vo am klarn Wossa, des erscheint tatsächli greablau.

outputs.target_text: But that is only the color of clear water, which actually appears gray-blue.

source.bar_text: De Farb hods in niederschlogsarme Zeitn, wenn da greaßte Teil vom Wossa aus de Quelln stammt.

outputs.target_text: The color is present in low-flow periods, when the greatest part of the water comes from the springs.

source.bar_text: Noch starke Regnfäll gibts durch Erosion an Haffa Schlamm und Dreck im Wossa, dann werds undurchsichtig lehmig braun.

outputs.target_text: After heavy rainfall, there is mud and dirt in the water due to erosion, then it becomes opaque, loamy brown.

source.bar_text: Iaba s' Enstehen vo dea greablaun Farb is ma se ned ganz einig.

outputs.target_text: I am not entirely sure about the emergence of the greenish-blue color.

source.bar_text: Wahrscheinlich is a Zammspui vo Algn und am glästn Koich.

outputs.target_text: Probably it is a collusion between Algn and the glästn Koich.

source.bar_text: Da Eindruck werd vastärkt durch de helln Koichsteana am Grund vom Fluß und dem sonst recht klarn Wossa.

outputs.target_text: The impression is reinforced by the bright pebbles at the bottom of the river and the otherwise quite clear water.

source.bar_text: Dadurch kimmt a Haffa Liacht aus'm Fluß zruck und iabastrahlt des vo da Oberflächn reflektierte Liacht.

outputs.target_text: As a result, a heap of light comes back from the river and it irradiates the light reflected from the surface.

source.bar_text: So hod de tatsächliche Farb vom Wassa an greaßan Eifluß auf an Farbeidruck ois de Farb vom Himme oda da Umgebung.

outputs.target_text: So the actual color of the water has a greater influence on a color print than the color of the sky or the surroundings.

source.bar_text: Fo da Farb is a as Biamischdrangl d'Isarmass inspiriad.

outputs.target_text: From the color, the beer mixture has been inspired by the iron mass.

source.bar_text: Zwischn Arzbach und Däiz is oana recht fleißig dabei, daß a noch am jedn Hochwassa seine Stoahaffa nei aufschicht.

outputs.target_text: Between Arzbach and Deiz, someone is quite busy making sure that he piles up his stone heaps again at every flood.

source.bar_text: De Haffa han ois Isarpyramidn bekannt und a scho mehrmois in da Zeidung und am Fernsehn erwähnt worn.

outputs.target_text: The harbors are known as Isar pyramids and have already been mentioned several times in the newspaper and on television.

source.bar_text: Da Erbauer sejba nend des Platzl Kloa-Kairo.

outputs.target_text: The builder himself doesn't think the little place is clear-cut.

source.bar_text: A Altarbuidl vo 1480 in da Jakobskirch in Lengrias is a Beispui fia oide Darstellunga vo da Isar.

outputs.target_text: An altar picture from 1480 in the St. James Church in Lengries is an example of old depictions of the Isar.

source.bar_text: Da unbkannte Moier hod s'Köpfn vom Apostel Jakobus ans Ufer vo da Isar valegt.

outputs.target_text: The unknown Moor laid the head of the Apostle James on the bank of the Isar.

source.bar_text: Im 19. Jahrhundert ham an Haffa Mola aus da Münchner Schui d' Isar ois Motiv fia eanane Buidl entdeckt.

outputs.target_text: In the 19th century, a lot of painters from the Munich School discovered the Isar as a motif for their pictures.

source.bar_text: Wei de recht gnau gmoid hom wern de Buidl a ois Dokumentation fia de Vaänderunga vo da Landschaft durch d'Leid ogseng.

outputs.target_text: Because they were painted very precisely, these pictures will also be seen by people as documentation of the changes to the landscape.

source.bar_text: Im Jäger vo Foi hod da Ludwig Ganghofer am Isarwinke und seine Bewohna a literarischs Denkmoi gsetzt und damit zur Bekanntheit vo der Gengd beitrong.

outputs.target_text: In "The Hunter of Fall," Ludwig Ganghofer created a literary monument to the Isarwinkel and its inhabitants, thereby contributing to the fame of the region.

source.bar_text: Oans vo am Willy Michl seine erfolgreichstn Liadl is as Isarflimmern.

outputs.target_text: One of Willy Michl's most successful songs is Isarflimmern.

source.bar_text: Er sejba hod an so starkn Bzug zum Fluß, daß a se Isarindianer nend.

outputs.target_text: He himself has such a strong attraction to the river that they call them the Isar Indians.

source.bar_text: Bejgien (Holländisch: België, Franzesisch: Belgique, Deitsch: Belgien), offiziäi Kinigreich Bejgien (holl.: Koninkrijk België, franz.: Royaume de Belgique) is a fedaral organisirschte parlamentarische Monarchie in Westeiropa, houd uma 10,5 Millionan Einwohna und is 30.528 km² gross und is a Mitglied vo da Eiropäischn Union.

outputs.target_text: Belgium (Dutch: België, French: Belgique, German: Belgien), officially Kingdom of Belgium (Dutch: Koninkrijk België, French: Royaume de Belgique) is a federally organized parliamentary monarchy in Western Europe, has around 10.5 million inhabitants and is 30,528 km² large and is a member of the European Union.

source.bar_text: Es grenzt an Holland, Deitschland, Luxnbuag, Frankreich und an de Nordsee.

outputs.target_text: It borders Holland, Germany, Luxembourg, France and the North Sea.

source.bar_text: Mid Holland und Luxnbuag zomm bijdt Bejgien de Beneluxstootn.

outputs.target_text: With Holland and Luxembourg, Belgium forms the Benelux states.

source.bar_text: Seid da Unobhängigkeit vo 1830 und da Vafossungsgewung vo 1831 is Bejgien a parlamentarische Monarchie.

outputs.target_text: Since the independence of 1830 and the constitutional victory of 1831, Belgium has been a parliamentary monarchy.

source.bar_text: De flämische Beväikarung im Noadn, da franzesische Sidn mid na Minderheit in da Haptstod Brissl und a kloane deitschsprouchige Beväikarung an Ostn bijdn an ohoitaschtn Konflikthead, dem wous seid de 1970er Jou durch a Denzentroiisirung vo da Stoutsorganisazion und 1993 durch de Umwondlung in an Bundesstout zan begegnan vasuacht woun is.

outputs.target_text: The Flemish population in the north, the French in the south with a minority in the capital Brussels, and a small German-speaking population in the east have been trying to counter an old conflict issue, which was attempted through a decentralization of the state organization in the 1970s and through the transformation into a federal state in 1993.

source.bar_text: Denneascht homd owa de gengsätzlichn Intressn vo de Vatreta vo de boadn grossn Beväikarungsgruppm (Sprouchgruppm gnonnt) weiderhi de bäigische Politik prägt und beeiflusst.

outputs.target_text: On this day, however, the opposing interests of the representatives of the large population groups in Belgium (referred to as language groups) have continued to shape and influence Belgian politics.

source.bar_text: Da Bundesstout Bejgien is in droi Gmoaschouftn (de flämische, franzesische und de deitsche Gmoaschouft) sowia in droi Regionan (Flandern, Wallonien und de Region Brissl-Hauptstod) eitoaet.

outputs.target_text: The federal state Belgium is divided into three communities (the Flemish, French, and German communities) as well as into three regions (Flanders, Wallonia, and the Brussels-Capital Region).

source.bar_text: Bejgien is a Grindungsmidgliad vo da Eiropäischn Wiatschoftsgmoaschoft (EWG), da heiting Eiropäischn Union (EU), vo dera de wichtigstn Instituziona in da Hauptstoud Brissl eanan Sitz homd.

outputs.target_text: Belgium is a founding member of the European Economic Community (EEC), the current European Union (EU), of which the most important institutions have their seat in the capital Brussels.

source.bar_text: Ougsechn vom Berglaund vo de Ardennen im Siidostn is Bejgien a weidgeheaschts ewernes Laund.

outputs.target_text: Cut off from the mountain range of the Ardennes in the southeast, Belgium is a somewhat eternal land.

source.bar_text: De Wossakantn dastreckt se auf 72,3 km.

outputs.target_text: The waterworks stretch out over 72.3 km.

source.bar_text: 25 Prozent vo da Laundesflächn wernd fia de Laundwirtschouft gnitzt.

outputs.target_text: 25 percent of the land area are used for agriculture.

source.bar_text: Uma 95 Prozent vo oie Bäigier leem in Städt.

outputs.target_text: Around 95 percent of all your legs live in cities.

source.bar_text: Laut de Berechnungan vom Kiniglichn Bäigischn Institut fia Naturwissnschouftn houd Bejgien a Flächn vo 30.528 km².

outputs.target_text: According to the calculations of the Royal Belgian Institute for Natural Sciences, Belgium has an area of 30,528 km².

source.bar_text: Im Vijväikerstout Bejgien leem holländisch reedeaschte Flamen (59% vo da Beväikarung), franzesischsprochige Wallonen (40%) und a deitschsprouchige Minderheit (Ripuarische Reinfrankn mid za. 1%) zomm.

outputs.target_text: In the Belgian population, Dutch-speaking Flemish (59% of the population), French-speaking Walloons (40%), and a German-speaking minority (Ripuarian Ripuarian with approx. 1%) live together.

source.bar_text: De weiderne Wonbeväikarung bestet aus Zuagwondeaschte aus vij Toaen vo Eiropa (bsundeascht aus Poin, Italien und Marokko).

outputs.target_text: The further population consists of incoming branches from five continents (especially from Asia, Italy and Morocco).

source.bar_text: In Bejgien gibbs heid droi Omtssprouchn: Holländisch (Flämisch san de holländischn Dialekt in Flandern), Franzesisch und Deitsch (san de westmittldeitschn Dialekt und de hochdeitsche Omtssprouch in Ostbejgien).

outputs.target_text: In Belgium there are three official languages today: Dutch (Flemish are the Dutch dialects in Flanders), French and German (are the West Central German dialects and the High German official language in East Belgium).

source.bar_text: Seid da Unouhänigkeit vo Bejgien 1830 houd alloa Franzesisch ois Omtssprouch vom Stout goitn.

outputs.target_text: Since the independence of Belgium in 1830, French alone has been the official language of the state.

source.bar_text: Im Jou 1873 is Holländisch ois zwoate offiziäie Omtssprouch im bäigischn Kinigreich rechtlich oerkonnt woun, owa trotzdem is d' Vawoitungs- und Untarichtssprouch in gonz Bejgien alloa Franzesisch gween.

outputs.target_text: In the year 1873, Dutch was legally recognized as the second official language in the Belgian Kingdom, but nevertheless, the administrative and educational language in all of Belgium was only French.

source.bar_text: 1919, oiso nouchm Erschtn Wäidkriag, is Deitsch ois Omtssprouch fir d' Leid im neich dazuagwungernen Gebiat an Ostn dazua kemma.

outputs.target_text: 1919, so after the First World War, German was added as the official language for the people in the newly annexed territory in the east.

source.bar_text: Erscht danouch houd d' grosse Merheit vo de Flamen mid Nouchdruck gfordeascht, dass eaner holländische Muattersprouch a ois Vawoitungs- und Unterrichtssprouch an Schuin und Universitätn vawendt und da franzesischn Omtssprouch gleichstäid weascht.

outputs.target_text: Only afterwards did the great majority of the French demand through pressure that they use the Dutch mother tongue as an administrative and instructional language at schools and universities and that it be made equal to the French official language.

source.bar_text: 1921 houd de bäigische Regirung de territoriale Oasprouchigkeit vo eanare Bewoner in de droi regionoin Sprouchgebiatn oerkonnt: de holländische Sprouchzone Flandern, de franzesische Sprouchzone Wallonie und de doudro grenzeaschte deitsche Sprouchzone in Ostbejgien.

outputs.target_text: In 1921, the Belgian government recognized the territorial linguistic character of its inhabitants in the three linguistic regions: the Dutch-speaking zone Flanders, the French-speaking zone Wallonia, and the German-speaking zone bordering Luxembourg in East Belgium.

source.bar_text: Des letzterne Gebiat houd zavur zan Deitschn Reich ghärscht und is nouch'm Erschtn Wäidkriag und duachn Versailler Vatroug an Bejgien ogschlossn woun.

outputs.target_text: The last territory belonged to the German Reich and was attached to Belgium after the First World War and through the Treaty of Versailles.

source.bar_text: An Status vo Regionoisprouchn houmd seid 1990 Lothringisch, Champenois, Fränkisch, Picardisch und Wallonisch.

outputs.target_text: A status of regional dialects has been Lotharingian, Champenois, Franconian, Picard, and Walloon since 1990.

source.bar_text: Ebber 75 Prozent vo de bäigischn Stoutsbiaga sand remisch-katholisch, runde 1 Prozent ghärnd ner protestantischn Kirch o, und 4 Prozent islamische Gmoana.

outputs.target_text: About 75 percent of the Bavarian stout drinkers are Roman Catholic, around 1 percent belong to the Protestant church, and 4 percent to Islamic communities.

source.bar_text: Da Otoae vo konfesionslose betroug uma 20 Prozent.

outputs.target_text: The proportion of non-religious people is around 20 percent.

source.bar_text: De federale bäigische Regiarung untastitzt und oerkennt seggs Religionan und a nid-konfesionäie Wäidoschaung o: de Anglikanische Kiach, en Islam, as Judndum, de Remisch-Katholische Kirch, de Orthodoxe Kiach, a uniate protestantische Kiach und de Freigeistige Wäidoschaungsgmoaschouft.

outputs.target_text: The federal Belgian government supports and recognizes six religions and a non-confessional worldview: the Anglican Church, Islam, Judaism, the Roman Catholic Church, the Orthodox Church, a uniate Protestant Church, and the freethinking worldview community.

source.bar_text: Berlin is de Bundeshaptstod und da Regiarungssitz vo Deitschland.

outputs.target_text: Berlin is the federal capital and the seat of government of Germany.

source.bar_text: Aussadem is s a oagnas Bundesland und as Zentrum vo da Metropolregion Berlin-Brandenburg.

outputs.target_text: Besides, it is a federal state and the center of the Berlin-Brandenburg metropolitan region.

source.bar_text: Berlin is mit uma 3,6 Milliona Einwohna de gresste Stod vo Deitschland (noch da Bevejkarung und noch da Flächn).

outputs.target_text: Berlin is with around 3.6 million inhabitants the largest city of Germany (according to the population and according to the area).

source.bar_text: In da EU is de gresste Stod noch da Bevejkarung und de fiatgresste noch da Flächn.

outputs.target_text: In the EU, it is the largest city after the population and the largest after the area.

source.bar_text: Berlin wor in seine Gschicht scho mehrfoch a Haptstod, wia beispuisweis vom Kurfiaschtndum Brandenburg, vum Kinireich Breissn, vum Deitschn Reich und vo da DDR (nua im Osttei vo da Stod).

outputs.target_text: Berlin was already a capital city several times in its history, for example of the Electorate of Brandenburg, of the Kingdom of Prussia, of the German Reich and of the GDR (only in the eastern part of the city).

source.bar_text: Seit da Wiedavaoanigung im Joar 1990 is Berlin gsamtdeitsche Haptstod.

outputs.target_text: Since the reunification in the year 1990, Berlin has been the all-German capital.

source.bar_text: Davor war des Bonn.

outputs.target_text: Before that was Bonn.

source.bar_text: Berlin is a bedeitens Zentrum vo Politik, Medien, Kuitua und Wissnschoft in Eiropa.

outputs.target_text: Berlin is an important center of politics, media, culture and science in Europe.

source.bar_text: De Stod is a wichtiga Vakeahsknotnpunkt und oane vo de moastbesuchtastn Städt vom Kontinent.

outputs.target_text: The city is an important transport hub and one of the most visited cities on the continent.

source.bar_text: De do ogfiadn Beispui buidn de de Klass 1 und 2 vo de stoarkn Substantive, vo dena as Kennzeichn a Umlautplural is.

outputs.target_text: Thus the sentence "Max Müller is the greatest of the twelve boys" can produce the following variants in Bavarian: "Of the twelve boys, Müller Max is the greatest (comparative)/the greatest (superlative)/seldom the greatest/the greatest."

source.bar_text: Boarische Zoiweata endn moastns af -e, des wo owa in attributiva Stejung oft wegfoid.

source.bar_text: Im Boarischn is da Iwagang vo da Wortbeigung zum Sotzbau (Sidntax) oft fliaßend, desweng kena vui Bereiche in da boarischen Grammatik vo da Morphosyntax am bestn eafosst wean.

outputs.target_text: In Bavarian, the transition from word inflection to sentence structure (syntax) is often fluid, which is why many areas in Bavarian grammar can best be understood as morphosyntax.

source.bar_text: Prepositiona kena im Boarischn wia im Deitschn mit am bestimmtn Artikl zu am Woat vaschmejzn (vgl. dt. bei dem = beim, an dem = am, unter den = untern usw.).

source.bar_text: Im Boarisch wead des vui efta ogwendt.

source.bar_text: Wei Prepositiona de Betonung af s nochfoigande Sotzelement lenka, kena eahna nua betonte, obwa nia unbetonte Peasonalpronomina foign.

outputs.target_text: Since prepositions direct the emphasis onto the following sentence element, they can only be stressed if no unstressed personal pronouns follow.

outputs.target_text: On holidays, depending on the region, it is either influenced by: in Easter, at Christmas; or by: on Easter, on Christmas; or under the influence of the standard language.

source.bar_text: Im Boarischn sogt ma soichane Weata owa nia nid ohne Prepositiona zua Zeitogob.

source.bar_text: Weidane Beispui: i wohn Augschburg, i wor Schui, ea gähd easchte Klass Schui (vgl. aa lat. Romae in Rom, Romam nach Rom; Hindi Dillî calnâ af Delhi foahn, stott Dillî ko calnâ).

source.bar_text: S Boarische hod a komplexes System vo Richtungsadverbialien, de wo oan Bezug zua Perspektivn vom Sprecha nehma.

outputs.target_text: Bavarian has a complex system of directional adverbials, which take a reference to the perspectives of the speaker.

source.bar_text: Wia im Deitschn muass, je noch dem, ob de Bewegung vom Sprecha weg oda zum Sprecha hi voizong wiad, a ensprechends Affix ogfiagt wean (im Weanarischn san de zwoa Affixe zammagfoin, s wead do oisdann koa Untaschied mea gmocht).

outputs.target_text: As in German, depending on whether the movement of the speaker is counted away from or towards the speaker, a corresponding affix must be attached (in Viennese, the two affixes have merged, so no distinction is made there anymore).

source.bar_text: Im Deitschn wean de Affixe ois Präfixe (hin- bzw. her-) vawendt, oisa am Adverb vorogstejt.

outputs.target_text: In German, the affixes are used as prefixes (hin- or her-), thus placed before the adverb.

source.bar_text: Im Boarischn wean de Affixe ois Suffixe eigsetzt, d. h. am Adverb hinten ogfiagt; s Suffix -hin wead zu -i, regional -e obgschwächt, s Suffix -her zu -a.

outputs.target_text: In Bavarian, the affixes are used as suffixes, i.e., attached to the end of the adverb; the suffix -hin becomes -i, regionally weakened to -e, the suffix -her to -a.

source.bar_text: De Iwasicht zoagt de Richtungsadverbien, wias worscheinli im gonzn boarischn Raum iblich gwen san.

source.bar_text: Im westlichn Obabayern gengan de Formen scho längere Zeit ollawei mehra zruck und ma verwendt Formen de näha on da Hochsproch und näha am Schwäbischn san.

outputs.target_text: In western Upper Bavaria, the forms have been receding more and more for a long time, and forms are being used that are closer to the standard language and closer to Swabian.

source.bar_text: Es is dort oiso im easchtn Schritt "auffi, auffa", "obi, oba", "eini, eina", "ummi, umma" durch "nauf, rauf", "no, ro", "nei, rei", "num, rum" ersetzt worn.

outputs.target_text: So, in the first step, it was replaced there by "up, up", "down, down", "in, in", "around, around" through "nauf, rauf", "no, ro", "nei, rei", "num, rum".

source.bar_text: Im Sidwestn vo Oberbayern hom se de Richtungsadverbien mit da Nochsuibm "i" und "a/ar/r" bessar hoitn kenna wia im Nordwestn vo Obabayern.

source.bar_text: Im Boarischn hods an Prozess gebm, dea wo in da Sprochwissnschoft Klitisiarung hoasst.

outputs.target_text: In Bavarian, there has been a process that is called cliticization in linguistics.

source.bar_text: Wos Boarische betrifft, so is damit s Drohenga vo Personalpronomina ans konjugiate Verb gmoant.

outputs.target_text: As far as Bavarian is concerned, the dropping of personal pronouns from a conjugated verb is meant by it.

source.bar_text: Aus mia wiad -ma, aus dia wiad -da, se wiad zu -s usw. Vo da Obschwechung is nacha aa nua mea a kloana Schritt zua Kontraktion vom Verb mitm Personalpronom.

outputs.target_text: From me becomes -ma, from you becomes -da, she becomes zu -s etc. After the weakening, it is then also just a small step towards the contraction of the verb with the personal pronoun.

source.bar_text: De Klitisiarung is a da Grund, weshoib s Pronoma vo da 1. Person Plural im Boarischn af m- olautet.

outputs.target_text: The declension is the reason why the pronoun of the 1st person plural in Bavarian ends in m.

source.bar_text: De middlhochdeitsche Verb-Endung -n und da Olaut vom Persoanalpronom wir san zum m vaschmoizn (ebenso im Schwäbischn).

outputs.target_text: The Middle High German verb ending -n and the umlaut of the personal pronoun wir are used to close m (likewise in Swabian).

source.bar_text: m is dann vom Sprecha nimma länga ois Verb-Endung ogseng worn, sondan ois Olaut vom Personalpronom.

outputs.target_text: it was then no longer seen as a verb ending from the speaker, but as a full vowel of the personal pronoun.

source.bar_text: Des Phänomen tritt oba ned nua in da 1. Person Plural im Nominativ af, a andane Persona wean klitisiat.

outputs.target_text: This phenomenon does not only occur in the 1st person plural in the nominative, other persons are also included.

source.bar_text: Omeakung: De klitisiatn Personalpronoma san durch Bindestriche trennt.

outputs.target_text: Note: The small personal pronouns are separated by hyphens.

source.bar_text: Im easchtn Beispui weads direkte Objekt (Akkusativobjekt) klitisiat, wearend im zwoatn Subjekt und Akkusativobjekt ons Verb ogfiagt wean.

outputs.target_text: In the first example, the direct object (accusative object) will be analyzed, whereas in the second, subject and accusative object will be attached to our verb.

source.bar_text: Im drittn Beispui gengan sogoa Subjekt, Akkusativ- und Dativobjekt a Vabindung mitm Verb ein.

outputs.target_text: In the third example, even subject, accusative and dative objects form a connection with the verb.

source.bar_text: Oba ned nua de Verbn kenna ois Element gnutzt wean, an de wo de obgschächtn Personalpronomina ogfiagt wean.

outputs.target_text: But not only the verbs can be used as an element, to which the sent personal pronouns are attached.

outputs.target_text: This is also possible with nebulizer inhalation.

source.bar_text: Wen a Personalpronoma klitisiat worn is, dann deaf de Voifoam davo nimma im gleichn Sotz vorkema: Se schloft oda Schloft-s?

outputs.target_text: Once a personal pronoun has been cliticized, then the full form of it may no longer appear in the same sentence: Does she sleep (Se schloft) or does she sleep (Schloft-s)?

source.bar_text: A Sondafoi und a Ausnohm za dem buidd de Nominativ-Form vo da 2. Person Singular und in an grossn Tei vom Boarischn aa de 2. Person Plural, sowia ia a poa Regiona aa de 1. Person Plural.

outputs.target_text: A special case and an exception to this picture, the nominative form of the 2nd person singular and in a large part of Bavarian also the 2nd person plural, as well as in a few regions also the 1st person plural.

source.bar_text: Do liegt nacha ned nua a Klitisiarung vor, sondan de ehemolign Klitika hom scho an Status vo ana Flexionsendung.

outputs.target_text: Then it is not just a cliticization that occurs, but the former clitics already have the status of a flexion ending.

source.bar_text: Das du vo da 2. Person Singular is scho im Oidhochdeitschn duach inverse Sotzstellung an de urspringliche Endung -s ogfiagt worn, de wo de heite aa standardsprochliche Endung -st eagem hod.

source.bar_text: Regional kena aa andane Obweichunga fiakema.

source.bar_text: De Isar is a Fluss, der wo vo de Oipn durch Minga fliaßt und letzendlich gengiba vo Degndorf in d Donau münden duat.

outputs.target_text: The Isar is a river that flows from the Alps through Munich and ultimately flows into the Danube opposite Deggendorf.

source.bar_text: Da Ursprung liagt in Estareich im Hinteraudoi vom Kawendl-Gebirg.

outputs.target_text: The origin lies in Austria in the Hinterautal of the Karwendel mountains.

source.bar_text: Zwischn Scharnitz und Mittnwoid fliaßts iaba d' Grenz vo Estareich noch Bayern (Deitschland).

outputs.target_text: Between Scharnitz and Mittenwald, it flows across the border from Austria to Bavaria (Germany).

source.bar_text: Se hod a Leng vo 295 Kilometa.

outputs.target_text: It has a length of 295 kilometers.

source.bar_text: Neba Minga liang de Städt Däiz, Freising, Moosburg und Landshuad an da Isar.

outputs.target_text: Besides Munich, the cities of Dachau, Freising, Moosburg and Landshut lie on the Isar.

source.bar_text: De greaßtn Zufliass han d' Amper bei Moosburg, d' Loisach bei Wolfratshausn und d' Moosach bei Freising.

outputs.target_text: The largest tributaries are the Amper near Moosburg, the Loisach near Wolfratshausen, and the Moosach near Freising.

source.bar_text: D' Isar is noch da Donau, am Inn und am Main da viertlängste Fluss in Bayern.

outputs.target_text: After the Danube, the Inn and the Main, the Isar is the fourth longest river in Bavaria.

source.bar_text: Lange Zeit hods ghoaßn, der Nama Isar dad ausm keltischn kemma und sovui wia reißnds Wossa (ys = schnej, reißnd und ura = Wossa, Fluss) bedeitn.

outputs.target_text: For a long time it was said that the name Isar came from Celtic and meant something like rushing water (ys = snow, rushing and ura = water, river).

source.bar_text: Des guid inzwischn ois vaaltate Meinung.

outputs.target_text: That is now considered an outdated opinion.

source.bar_text: D'Sprachforscher moana jetzad es dad vo da indogermanischn Wurzl es/is (fia fließnds Wossa) kemma, de se a in fui andane Flußnama wiadafindt und se in aktuelle Sprachn nua no aufs feste Wossa, oiso s Eis bziagt.

outputs.target_text: Language researchers now think that it would have come from the Indo-European root es/is (for flowing water), which is also found in many other river names and, in current languages, only refers to solid water, i.e., ice.

source.bar_text: A guads Drum vom Wossa des auf'd boarischn Oipn unds Kawendl foid fliaßt durch d' Isar zur Donau und so bis ins Schwoazze Meea.

outputs.target_text: A good amount of water that falls on the Bavarian Alps and the Karwendel flows through the Isar to the Danube and so on into the Black Sea.

source.bar_text: S' gsamte Einzugsgebiat hod a Flächn vo 9000 Quadratkilometa.

source.bar_text: Wei a Guads vom Niedaschlog in de Berg ois Schnee foid hods zur Schneeschmelz as meiste Wossa.

source.bar_text: Mit am mittlern Abfluss vo 175 Kubikmeta in da Sekund zählt d' Isar zu de mittlgroßn deitschn Flüss.

source.bar_text: Ma kos sogseng mit am Lech, da Mosel, am Main und am Neckar vagleicha.

source.bar_text: De meistn Inseln und Kiesbänk in da Isar untaliegn wega de starkn Hochwassa a ständign Änderung in ihra Form und Log.

source.bar_text: D'Isar werd auf vaschiedne Artn zur Energie-Gewinnung gnutzt.

outputs.target_text: In the further course, there are several hydroelectric power plants, e.g., on the northern outskirts of Deggendorf and the Isar plants 1-3 near Munich.

outputs.target_text: Even the side channels for the hydroelectric power plants, e.g., in the vicinity of Munich, withdraw water from the wild river course.

source.bar_text: Außadem vahindern de Wehre an Transport vom Geschiebe.

outputs.target_text: However, there are limits to that; in one hot summer, the nuclear power plant already had to be throttled, otherwise it would not have met the environmental requirements.

source.bar_text: Fast scho zum Nama dazua gheard ois Zuasotz da Farbeidruck.

outputs.target_text: In 'The Hunter of Fall,' Ludwig Ganghofer created a literary monument to the Isarwinkel and its inhabitants, thereby contributing to the fame of the region.

source.bar_text: De haifigstn Meglichkeitn vo da Pluralbuidung san Umlaut od Suffigiarung; boade Meglichkeitn kena aa kombiniad wean.

outputs.target_text: The most common possibilities for plural formation are umlaut or suffixation; both possibilities can also be combined.

source.bar_text: De do ogfiadn Beispui buidn de de Klass 1 und 2 vo de stoarkn Substantive, vo dena as Kennzeichn a Umlautplural is.

outputs.target_text: The examples listed here form classes 1 and 2 of the strong substantives, which are characterized by an umlaut plural.

source.bar_text: De Klass (S1) hod nebmam Umlaut koa weidas Pluralkennzoachn, is oiso endungslos; ia ghean nur Maskulina und Feminina o. Oft kimmt im Plural no a Vokalkiazung dazua, beispuisweis: Hand – Händt, Stod – Städt, Wand – Wändt, Grund – Grindt.

outputs.target_text: The class (S1) has no further plural marker besides the umlaut, so it is thus endless; it only belongs to masculines and feminines. Often, a vowel shortening is also added in the plural, for example: Hand – Händt, Stod – Städt, Wand – Wändt, Grund – Grindt.

source.bar_text: Zua Klass S2, de wo im Umlautplural plus Endung -a (de wo moastns da deitschn Endung -er entspricht) hom, ghean oanige Maskulina und vui Neutra.

outputs.target_text: The class S2, which has the umlaut plural plus the ending -a (which mostly corresponds to the German ending -er), includes other masculines and many neuters.

source.bar_text: Es gejten de gleichn Umlautregeln wia obm:

outputs.target_text: The same umlaut rules apply as above:

source.bar_text: Zur Klasse S3 ghean olle Maskulina, Feminina und Neutra ohne Umlaut mit Pluralendung -a; dabei endn de moastn Feminina im Singular af de urspringlige Dativendung -n.

outputs.target_text: Class S3 includes all masculines, feminines, and neuters without an umlaut with the plural ending -a; in doing so, most feminines end in the singular with the original dative ending -n.

source.bar_text: Ois letzte storke Klasse (S4) gejten Substantive mit Nullplural, zum Beispui ‚Fisch‘

outputs.target_text: As the last strong class (S4), nouns with zero plural apply, for example 'Fisch'

source.bar_text: (m) und ‚Schof‘

outputs.target_text: (m) and 'Schof'

source.bar_text: In manchen Dialektn druckn de Substantive den Plural owa durch Vokalkiazung oda -längung aus, beispuisweis da Hund und de Hundt.

outputs.target_text: In some dialects, the nouns express the plural through vowel shortening or lengthening, for example the dog and the dogs.

source.bar_text: De Klass bstäht eigentli nur aus Maskulina und Neutra; olle Feminina af -n, de wo historisch gseng zu de schwochn Substantivn ghean, kena owa aa dazuazejt wean, wei ia Plural ebenso unmarkiat is: ‚Antn – Antn‘ „Ente“.

outputs.target_text: The class actually consists only of masculines and neuters; all feminines ending in -n, which historically belong to the weak nouns, can however also be counted among them, because their plural is likewise unmarked: 'Antn – Antn' 'duck'.

source.bar_text: De Feminina wexln owa langsam zur Gruppe S3 und nehman im Plural de Endung -a o (vgl. obm s Beispui Ein „Eule“).

outputs.target_text: The feminine forms are however slowly changing to group S3 and take the ending -a in the plural (cf. the example above, an “Eule”).

source.bar_text: Vuifoch wead d/ iwa de Wortgrenz wegga assimiliat (Sandhi), so hoassts moastns Nom.

outputs.target_text: Often, it is assimilated (Sandhi) across the word boundary, so it is mostly Nom.

source.bar_text: b Vodan und b Buam(a).

outputs.target_text: and the father and the boy(s).

source.bar_text: Ebenso wia Voda flektian Baua, Boi, Breiss, Depp, Buasch [österr.], Frank, Franzos, Hiasch, Hos, Läw und andare mehr.

outputs.target_text: Just as Father, farmers, boys, brutes, idiots, youths [Austrian], Franks, Frenchmen, rascals, scoundrels, rascals and others more.

source.bar_text: Ähnli wia Bua flektian de Wärter Rob und Schwob: olle Forman außa Nominativ Singular hom an Stej vo -b an Stammauslaut -m: Rom (Robm), Schwom (Schwobm); de Pluralform Roma (Robma), Schwoma (Schwobma) san sejtn.

outputs.target_text: Similar to Bua, the words Rob and Schwob decline: all forms except nominative singular have a change from -b to the stem consonant -m: Rom (Robm), Schwom (Schwobm); the plural forms Roma (Robma), Schwoma (Schwobma) are rare.

source.bar_text: As grammatische Gschlecht vo an Substantiv wead am Artikel markiat.

outputs.target_text: The grammatical gender of a noun is marked by the article.

source.bar_text: Oft is as Gschlecht wia im Deitschn.

outputs.target_text: Often the gender is like in German.

source.bar_text: Bei de Personalpronomina untascheidd s Boarische teiweis, so wia vui romanische und slawische Sprochn, zwischn betontn und unbetontn Foama im Dativ (nur 1.,

outputs.target_text: Regarding the personal pronouns, Bavarian partially distinguishes, like many Romance and Slavic languages, between stressed and unstressed forms in the dative (only 1.,

source.bar_text: 2. Singular) und Akkusativ (nur

outputs.target_text: 2. Singular) and accusative (only

source.bar_text: * De Foama gejten ois „weniga“ boarisch, san dafia oba typisch ostfränggisch.

outputs.target_text: * These forms are considered “less” Bavarian, but are in return typically East Franconian.

source.bar_text: Bei da Kombination vo mearan unbetontn Personalpronomina, de wo af -'s verkiazt san, wead da Bindevokal -a- einegschom; bei da Reihenfoige vo da Ordnung gibts, im Gengasotz zum Deitschn, vaschiedane Variantn.

outputs.target_text: In the case of a combination of several unstressed personal pronouns that are shortened with -'s, the connecting vowel -a- is inserted; regarding the sequence of the order, in contrast to German, there are different variants.

source.bar_text: Dabei ko in (1.a) und (1.b) ebmso weng wia im Deitschn untaschiedn wean, obsa si bei erra um de 3. Person Singular feminin oda um de 3. Person Plural handlt.

outputs.target_text: In this regard, (1.a) and (1.b) can be distinguished about as much as in German, whether it concerns the 3rd person singular feminine or the 3rd person plural.

source.bar_text: Aa de Possessivpronomina deina und seina flektiaen so.

outputs.target_text: The possessive pronouns deina and seina inflect like that.

source.bar_text: S Possessivpronomen (Fem. Sg.) iara is vom Standarddeitschn iwanumma woan; urspringli vawendt s Boarische fia weibliche Bsitza ebmfois s Pronomen seina.

outputs.target_text: The possessive pronoun (fem. sg.) iara was generally taken from Standard German; originally, Bavarian also used the pronoun seina for female owners.

source.bar_text: Oft wead a s substantiviate Adjektiv da mei(nige) (da dei(nige), da sei(nige), im Plural: de meinign, de deinign …) vawendt: „Wem ghead der?“ – „Des is da mei!“

outputs.target_text: Often a substantivized adjective is used as my (yours, his, in the plural: mine, yours, his ...) : “Whom does it belong to?” – “That is mine!”

source.bar_text: So wia de Possessivpronomina flektian de Indefinitpronomina koana sowia oana; ma ko vors Letztare s Wort iagad- stejn.

outputs.target_text: Just as the possessive pronouns inflect, the indefinite pronouns koana and oana do so in the same way; one can place the word iagad- before the last syllable.

source.bar_text: Do wead oiso ned zwischn de Geschlechta, sundan zwischn Persona und Socha untaschiedn.

outputs.target_text: So, one does not distinguish between the genders, but rather between person and thing.

source.bar_text: Vui vo de boarischn Adjektive hom a Kurzfoam und a Langfoam.

outputs.target_text: Many of the Bavarian adjectives have a short form and a long form.

source.bar_text: De Kurzfoam wead in prädikativa Stellung vawendt.

outputs.target_text: The short form is used in a predicative position.

source.bar_text: D. h. dann, wen s Adjektiv mitm Huifsverb sein a Prädikat buidt (de Schuah san schwoaz).

outputs.target_text: I.e. then, when the adjective forms a predicate with the auxiliary verb (the shoes are black).

source.bar_text: De Langfoam kimmt dann vor, wann s Adjektiv ois Attribut vo am Substantiv vawendt wead (de schwoazn Schuah).

outputs.target_text: The long form then occurs when the adjective is used as an attribute of a noun (the black shoes).

source.bar_text: Moastns liegt da Untaschied zwischn Kurz- und Langfoam im Endkonsonanten.

outputs.target_text: Mostly, the difference between short and long forms lies in the final consonant.

source.bar_text: Oft san des -n, -ch, -g.

outputs.target_text: Often these are -n, -ch, -g.

source.bar_text: Wia im Deitschn wean Adjektive in attributiva Stejung flektiat, d. h. se griagn vaschiedne Endunga.

outputs.target_text: As in German, adjectives in attributive position are inflected, i.e., they receive different endings.

source.bar_text: Dabei muass untaschiedn wean, obs mid an Substantiv mid bstimmtn Artikl gengan (und dahea sejm in bstimmta Foam flektian), oda obs mid an unbstimmtn Artikl zamm san (und nacha dementsprechend nach an unbstimmtn Musta dekliniat wean).

outputs.target_text: In this case, a distinction must be made whether it is with a noun with a definite article (and therefore must be inflected in a certain form), or whether it is together with an indefinite article (and is then subsequently declined according to an indefinite pattern).

source.bar_text: Wean Adjektive substantiviat vawendt, oiso nua mit Artikl, nacha richtn sa si ebnfois noch dem.

outputs.target_text: When adjectives are used substantively, i.e., only with an article, they also inflect accordingly.

source.bar_text: Ois Beispui deant as Adjektiv schee, des wo am Stamm bei da Flexion um -n daweitad wead (aussa beim Neutrum Singular).

outputs.target_text: As an example, the adjective 'schee' serves, which is extended by -n at the stem during inflection (except in the neuter singular).

source.bar_text: Im Boarischen deant as Suffix -a zur Buidung vom Komparativ, vo da easchtn Steigarungsform.

outputs.target_text: In Bavarian, the suffix -a serves for the formation of the comparative, from the first degree of comparison.

source.bar_text: Grundlog vom Komparativ is de obm bschriebane Langform; bei mangn Adjektivn kimts zu Umlautn, bei andan zua Vaendarung in da Vokalleng oda im konsonantischn Auslaut.

outputs.target_text: The basis of the comparative is the long form described above; with many adjectives it leads to umlauts, with others to a change in the vowel or in the consonantal coda.

source.bar_text: Fian Superlativ wead je nach Landschaft, a eigane Form af -st buidd oda owa aa ned.

outputs.target_text: For the superlative, depending on the region, a special form ending in -st is formed, or not.

source.bar_text: In letztan Foi wead da Komparativ ois Superlativasotz heagnumma.

outputs.target_text: In the last case, the comparative is taken as a superlative sentence.

source.bar_text: So ko da Sotz „Max Müller ist der größte der zwölf Knaben“ im Boarischen foigende Varianten produzian: „Vo de zwejf Buam is da Müller Max am gressan (Komparativ)/am gresstn (Superlativ)/sejtn da gresste/da gressane.“

outputs.target_text: Thus the sentence “Max Müller is the greatest of the twelve boys” can produce the following variants in Bavarian: “Of the twelve boys, Müller Max is the greatest (comparative)/the greatest (superlative)/seldom the greatest/the greatest.”

source.bar_text: Boarische Zoiweata endn moastns af -e, des wo owa in attributiva Stejung oft wegfoid.

outputs.target_text: Bavarian number words mostly end in -e, which however often falls away in the attributive position.

source.bar_text: De Numeralia flektian ned, Ausnohm is as Zoiwoat oans fia de Zoi 1.

outputs.target_text: The numerals do not inflect, with the exception of the number word one for the number 1.

source.bar_text: Im Boarischn is da Iwagang vo da Wortbeigung zum Sotzbau (Sidntax) oft fliaßend, desweng kena vui Bereiche in da boarischen Grammatik vo da Morphosyntax am bestn eafosst wean.

outputs.target_text: In Bavarian, the transition from word inflection to sentence structure (syntax) is often fluid, which is why many areas in Bavarian grammar can best be understood as morphosyntax.

source.bar_text: Prepositiona kena im Boarischn wia im Deitschn mit am bestimmtn Artikl zu am Woat vaschmejzn (vgl. dt. bei dem = beim, an dem = am, unter den = untern usw.).

outputs.target_text: Prepositions in Bavarian, like in German, can merge with a certain article into a word (cf. German bei dem = beim, an dem = am, unter den = untern etc.).

source.bar_text: Im Boarisch wead des vui efta ogwendt.

outputs.target_text: In Bavarian, this is used much more frequently.

source.bar_text: Wei Prepositiona de Betonung af s nochfoigande Sotzelement lenka, kena eahna nua betonte, obwa nia unbetonte Peasonalpronomina foign.

outputs.target_text: Since prepositions direct the emphasis onto the following sentence element, they can only be stressed if no unstressed personal pronouns follow.

source.bar_text: Im Boarischn wean fia Ortschaftn und Städt eascht seitm Eifluss ausm Hochdeitschn aa "nach" und "in" braucht.

outputs.target_text: In Bavarian, too, the words for towns and cities, such as 'nach' and 'in', are only used since the influence of High German.

source.bar_text: Traditionej sogt ma im Boarischn owa a oda af/auf (= nach) und z (= in).

outputs.target_text: Traditionally, however, one says in Bavarian also 'oda af/auf' (= nach) and 'z' (= in).

source.bar_text: Ma foaht oisdann af Augschburg oda bleibt z Minga.

outputs.target_text: One then drives to Augsburg or stays in Munich.

source.bar_text: Bei Feiatog findt se je noch Region entweda ebmfois as z: z Ostan, z Weihnachtn; oda af: af Ostan, af Weihnachtn; oda untam Eifluss vo da Standardsproch an.

outputs.target_text: On holidays, depending on the region, it is either influenced by: either 'z: z Ostan, z Weihnachtn' [at Easter, at Christmas]; or 'af: af Ostan, af Weihnachtn' [on Easter, on Christmas]; or by the influence of the standard language.

source.bar_text: Im Boarischn sogt ma soichane Weata owa nia nid ohne Prepositiona zua Zeitogob.

outputs.target_text: In Bavarian, however, such words are never said regarding a time of day without prepositions.

source.bar_text: A regionale Besonderheit is de temporale Konjunktion aft, de wo in großn Toaln vom boarischn Sprochgebiet vawendt wiad.

outputs.target_text: A regional peculiarity is the temporal conjunction 'aft', which is used in large parts of the Bavarian language area.

source.bar_text: Etymologisch gseng entspricht des am englischn after und hoasst „nacha, danoch“.

outputs.target_text: Etymologically speaking, this corresponds to the English 'after' and means 'after, afterwards'.

source.bar_text: In de siidboarischn Dialekte tretn präpositionslose Orts- und Richtungsogobm (Adverbialien) af.

outputs.target_text: In the South Bavarian dialects, prepositionless locational and directional specifications (adverbials) occur.

source.bar_text: Ma gähd oisdann ned in de Kira oda afn Moakt, sundan ma gähd Kira/Moakt, ohne a Präposition z vawendn.

outputs.target_text: One doesn't go into the church or to the market then, but one goes church/market, without using a preposition.

source.bar_text: De Lokalbedeitung wiad duachs Ausbleibm vom Artikl markiat, dea wo sont bei jedm Substantiv obligatorisch is.

outputs.target_text: The local meaning is marked through the absence of the article, which is otherwise mandatory with every noun.

source.bar_text: Weidane Beispui: i wohn Augschburg, i wor Schui, ea gähd easchte Klass Schui (vgl. aa lat. Romae in Rom, Romam nach Rom; Hindi Dillî calnâ af Delhi foahn, stott Dillî ko calnâ).

outputs.target_text: Further examples: I live in Augsburg, I was at school, he goes to first grade school (cf. also lat. Romae in Rome, Romam to Rome; Hindi Dillî calnâ from Delhi, instead of Dillî ko calnâ).

source.bar_text: S Boarische hod a komplexes System vo Richtungsadverbialien, de wo oan Bezug zua Perspektivn vom Sprecha nehma.

outputs.target_text: Bavarian has a complex system of directional adverbials, which take a reference to the perspectives of the speaker.

source.bar_text: Wia im Deitschn muass, je noch dem, ob de Bewegung vom Sprecha weg oda zum Sprecha hi voizong wiad, a ensprechends Affix ogfiagt wean (im Weanarischn san de zwoa Affixe zammagfoin, s wead do oisdann koa Untaschied mea gmocht).

outputs.target_text: As in German, depending on whether the movement is counted away from or towards the speaker, a corresponding affix must be attached (in Viennese, the two affixes have merged, so no distinction is made there anymore).

source.bar_text: Im Deitschn wean de Affixe ois Präfixe (hin- bzw. her-) vawendt, oisa am Adverb vorogstejt.

outputs.target_text: In German, the affixes are used as prefixes (hin- or her-), thus placed before the adverb.

source.bar_text: Im Boarischn wean de Affixe ois Suffixe eigsetzt, d. h. am Adverb hinten ogfiagt; s Suffix -hin wead zu -i, regional -e obgschwächt, s Suffix -her zu -a.

outputs.target_text: In Bavarian, the affixes are used as suffixes, i.e., attached to the end of the adverb; the suffix -hin becomes -i, regionally weakened to -e, the suffix -her to -a.

source.bar_text: De Iwasicht zoagt de Richtungsadverbien, wias worscheinli im gonzn boarischn Raum iblich gwen san.

outputs.target_text: The overview shows the directional adverbs as they were probably common throughout the entire Bavarian region.

source.bar_text: Im westlichn Obabayern gengan de Formen scho längere Zeit ollawei mehra zruck und ma verwendt Formen de näha on da Hochsproch und näha am Schwäbischn san.

outputs.target_text: In western Upper Bavaria, the forms have been receding more and more for a long time, and forms are being used that are closer to the standard language and closer to Swabian.

source.bar_text: Es is dort oiso im easchtn Schritt "auffi, auffa", "obi, oba", "eini, eina", "ummi, umma" durch "nauf, rauf", "no, ro", "nei, rei", "num, rum" ersetzt worn.

outputs.target_text: There, in the first step, it was replaced by 'nauf, rauf', 'no, ro', 'nei, rei', 'num, rum' instead of 'auffi, auffa', 'obi, oba', 'eini, eina', 'ummi, umma'.

source.bar_text: Wei se "no, ro" und "num", "rum" aa net so hochsprochli ohearn, wead des haintztog aa oft mit "nunta, runta" und "niba/nüba, riba/riwa/rüba" ersetzt.

outputs.target_text: Because they [the forms] 'no, ro' and 'num', 'rum' also do not sound so high-register, this is also often replaced nowadays with 'nunta, runta' and 'niba/nüba, riba/riwa/rüba'.

source.bar_text: Es gibt an broatn Stroafa wo ma "nauf, rauf"... und "auffi/auffar" … nebmanand verwendt.

outputs.target_text: There is a broad range where one uses both 'nauf, rauf'... and 'auffi/auffar' … side by side.

source.bar_text: Im Sidwestn vo Oberbayern hom se de Richtungsadverbien mit da Nochsuibm "i" und "a/ar/r" bessar hoitn kenna wia im Nordwestn vo Obabayern.

outputs.target_text: In the southwest of Upper Bavaria, they were able to hold onto the directional adverbs with the suffix 'i' and 'a/ar/r' better than in the northwest of Upper Bavaria.

source.bar_text: Im Boarischn hods an Prozess gebm, dea wo in da Sprochwissnschoft Klitisiarung hoasst.

outputs.target_text: In Bavarian, there has been a process that is called cliticization in linguistics.

source.bar_text: Wos Boarische betrifft, so is damit s Drohenga vo Personalpronomina ans konjugiate Verb gmoant.

outputs.target_text: As far as Bavarian is concerned, this refers to the cliticization of personal pronouns to a conjugated verb.

source.bar_text: Aus mia wiad -ma, aus dia wiad -da, se wiad zu -s usw. Vo da Obschwechung is nacha aa nua mea a kloana Schritt zua Kontraktion vom Verb mitm Personalpronom.

outputs.target_text: From me becomes -ma, from you becomes -da, she becomes zu -s etc. After the weakening, it is then also just a small step towards the contraction of the verb with the personal pronoun.

source.bar_text: De Klitisiarung is a da Grund, weshoib s Pronoma vo da 1. Person Plural im Boarischn af m- olautet.

outputs.target_text: Cliticization is also the reason why the pronoun of the 1st person plural in Bavarian ends in m.

source.bar_text: De middlhochdeitsche Verb-Endung -n und da Olaut vom Persoanalpronom wir san zum m vaschmoizn (ebenso im Schwäbischn).

outputs.target_text: The Middle High German verb ending -n and the umlaut of the personal pronoun wir are used to merge into m (likewise in Swabian).

source.bar_text: m is dann vom Sprecha nimma länga ois Verb-Endung ogseng worn, sondan ois Olaut vom Personalpronom.

outputs.target_text: m is then no longer perceived as a verb ending by the speaker, but as a full vowel of the personal pronoun.

source.bar_text: Des Phänomen tritt oba ned nua in da 1. Person Plural im Nominativ af, a andane Persona wean klitisiat.

outputs.target_text: This phenomenon does not only occur in the 1st person plural in the nominative, other persons are also cliticized.

source.bar_text: Omeakung: De klitisiatn Personalpronoma san durch Bindestriche trennt.

outputs.target_text: Note: The cliticized personal pronouns are separated by hyphens.

source.bar_text: Im easchtn Beispui weads direkte Objekt (Akkusativobjekt) klitisiat, wearend im zwoatn Subjekt und Akkusativobjekt ons Verb ogfiagt wean.

outputs.target_text: In the first example, the direct object (accusative object) is cliticized, whereas in the second, the subject and accusative object are attached to the verb.

source.bar_text: Im drittn Beispui gengan sogoa Subjekt, Akkusativ- und Dativobjekt a Vabindung mitm Verb ein.

outputs.target_text: In the third example, even subject, accusative and dative objects form a connection with the verb.

source.bar_text: Oba ned nua de Verbn kenna ois Element gnutzt wean, an de wo de obgschächtn Personalpronomina ogfiagt wean.

outputs.target_text: But not only the verbs can be used as an element to which the cliticized personal pronouns are attached.

source.bar_text: Des is aa bei Nebmsotzeinleitan mäglich.

outputs.target_text: This is also possible with subordinate clause initiators.

source.bar_text: Wen a Personalpronoma klitisiat worn is, dann deaf de Voifoam davo nimma im gleichn Sotz vorkema: Se schloft oda Schloft-s?

outputs.target_text: Once a personal pronoun has been cliticized, then the full form of it may no longer appear in the same sentence: Se schloft or Schloft-s?

source.bar_text: owa nia ned Se schloft-s, des warad ungrammatisch.

outputs.target_text: but never ever she sleeps-s, that would be ungrammatical.

source.bar_text: A Sondafoi und a Ausnohm za dem buidd de Nominativ-Form vo da 2. Person Singular und in an grossn Tei vom Boarischn aa de 2. Person Plural, sowia ia a poa Regiona aa de 1. Person Plural.

outputs.target_text: A special case and an exception to this picture: the nominative form of the 2nd person singular and, in a large part of Bavarian, also the 2nd person plural, as well as in a few regions also the 1st person plural.

source.bar_text: Do liegt nacha ned nua a Klitisiarung vor, sondan de ehemolign Klitika hom scho an Status vo ana Flexionsendung.

outputs.target_text: In this case, it is not just cliticization that occurs, but the former clitics already have the status of a flexion ending.

source.bar_text: Das du vo da 2. Person Singular is scho im Oidhochdeitschn duach inverse Sotzstellung an de urspringliche Endung -s ogfiagt worn, de wo de heite aa standardsprochliche Endung -st eagem hod.

outputs.target_text: The 'du' of the 2nd person singular was already attached to the original ending -s through inverse word order in Old High German, which has since been replaced by today's standard language ending -st.

source.bar_text: Regional kena aa andane Obweichunga fiakema.

outputs.target_text: Regionally, other deviations can also occur.

source.bar_text: Manche Verbn vom Boarischn erfordan a andane Rektion wia im Standarddeitschn, z. B. diaschtn („duastig sei“), drama („träumen“) und rein („bereuen“).

outputs.target_text: Some verbs of Bavarian require a different government than in Standard German, e.g., diaschtn (“to be dusty”), drama (“to dream”) and rein (“to regret”).

source.bar_text: Se wean mitm logischn Subjektiv im Dativ oda Akkusativ gnuzd (sog. Quirky Case).

outputs.target_text: They are used with the logical subject in the dative or accusative (so-called Quirky Case).

source.bar_text: A formals Subjekt ist efta ned voahandn.

outputs.target_text: A formal subject is often not present beforehand.

source.bar_text: Im Boarischn wean, andas wiar im Standarddeitschn, Adjektive in attributiva Stejung markiat; dazu deant s invariable Suffix -a bzw. -e; s handelt se dobei um erstoarte Nom.

outputs.target_text: In Bavarian, unlike in Standard German, adjectives in the attributive position are marked; for this purpose, the invariable suffix -a or -e is used; these are strengthened nouns.

source.bar_text: -Forman (maskulin bzw. feminin).

outputs.target_text: -forms (masculine or feminine).

outputs.target_text: After his brief return from exile, Napoleon was finally defeated in 1815 at the Battle of Waterloo, and the Bourbon monarchy was restored with new constitutional limitations.

source.bar_text: Napoléon hod grouße Tei vo Eiropa beheascht.

outputs.target_text: Napoleon ruled large parts of Europe.

source.bar_text: Napoléon hod grouße Tei vo Eiropa beheascht.

outputs.target_text: France reached its political and military zenith in the early 19th century under Napoleon Bonaparte, subjugating much of continental Europe and establishing the First French Empire.

source.bar_text: Mit seina Niedalog san de moastn Eaobarunga wieda valoan woan.

outputs.target_text: With his defeat, most of the conquests were lost again.

source.bar_text: Mit seina Niedalog san de moastn Eaobarunga wieda valoan woan.

outputs.target_text: France reached its political and military zenith in the early 19th century under Napoleon Bonaparte, subjugating much of continental Europe and establishing the First French Empire. Its collapse initiated a period of relative decline during which France endured the Bourbon Restoration until the founding of the French Second Republic, which was succeeded by the Second French Empire upon Napoleon III's takeover.

source.bar_text: Noch da Restauration vo da Monarchie hod Frankreich sei Mocht owa wieda ausbaut, hod weidane Kolonien eaobat und hodn Ospruch afs gsomte Rhein-Westufa eahom.

outputs.target_text: After the restoration of the monarchy, France however rebuilt its power, acquired further colonies, and laid claim to the whole of Rhineland-Westphalia.

source.bar_text: Noch da Restauration vo da Monarchie hod Frankreich sei Mocht owa wieda ausbaut, hod weidane Kolonien eaobat und hodn Ospruch afs gsomte Rhein-Westufa eahom.
In Frankreich gibts a Buidungspflichd owa koa Schuipflicht.

outputs.target_text: In France there is compulsory education, but no compulsory schooling.

source.bar_text: In Frankreich gibts a Buidungspflichd owa koa Schuipflicht.
Des hoaßt de Buidung ko ma si aa duach Hausuntaricht oda duach sejm lerna beibringa.

outputs.target_text: That means education can also be acquired through homeschooling or by teaching oneself.

Frankreich untahoit Natuaschutzgebiet in vaschiedanen Kategorien im eiropäischn Kernland und in de Iwasää-Départements.

outputs.target_text: France maintains nature reserves in various categories in the European mainland and in the overseas departments.

source.bar_text: Frankreich untahoit Natuaschutzgebiet in vaschiedanen Kategorien im eiropäischn Kernland und in de Iwasää-Départements.

outputs.target_text: There are nine national parks and 46 natural parks.

source.bar_text: Weidane Natuaschutzgebiet san in Planung und Voabereitung.

outputs.target_text: Further nature reserves are in planning and preparation.

source.bar_text: Weidane Natuaschutzgebiet san in Planung und Voabereitung.
De Geografie is de Wissnschoft vo da Erdobaflächn, vom Roum und Oat vo da Eadn im ojgemeinen und a vo da Beschoffnheid da Eadn söbsd.

outputs.target_text: Geography is the science of the Earth's surface, of the space and nature of the Earth in general and also of the nature of the Earth itself.

source.bar_text: De Geografie is de Wissnschoft vo da Erdobaflächn, vom Roum und Oat vo da Eadn im ojgemeinen und a vo da Beschoffnheid da Eadn söbsd.

outputs.target_text: Geography is a systematic study of the Earth (other celestial bodies are specified, such as "geography of Mars", or given another name, such as areography in the case of Mars, or selenography in the case of the Moon, or planetography for the general case), its features, and phenomena that take place on it.

source.bar_text: Se eafosd, bschreibd und eakläat de Struktuan und de Vuagäng ouf da Eadobaflächn und emfois de Auswiakungen ouffn Menschn und de Hondlungen vo d'Menschn.

outputs.target_text: It explores, describes, and explains the structures and the processes on the Earth's surface and also the effects on humans and the actions of humans.

source.bar_text: Se eafosd, bschreibd und eakläat de Struktuan und de Vuagäng ouf da Eadobaflächn und emfois de Auswiakungen ouffn Menschn und de Hondlungen vo d'Menschn.

outputs.target_text: Geographers study the Earth's spatial and temporal distribution of phenomena, processes, and features as well as the interaction of humans and their environment.

source.bar_text: De Geografie buidt de Bruggn zwischn de oanzelnen Natua- und Sozjoiwissnschofftn.

outputs.target_text: Geography builds the bridge between the individual natural and social sciences.

source.bar_text: De Geografie buidt de Bruggn zwischn de oanzelnen Natua- und Sozjoiwissnschofftn.

outputs.target_text: Geography has been called "a bridge between natural science and social science disciplines."

source.bar_text: Se enwtickit de Konzepte zua Vaständnis und zua Löösung vo de Probleme zwischn da Wöd und' Menschn.

outputs.target_text: It develops the concepts for understanding and for solving the problems between the world and humans.

source.bar_text: Se enwtickit de Konzepte zua Vaständnis und zua Löösung vo de Probleme zwischn da Wöd und' Menschn.
Gegnstond vo da Geografie is de gsommte Geosfäre.

outputs.target_text: The subject of geography is the entire geosphere.
